start.title: The Plains of Moab
start.text:
Israel rests at the edge of promise.
Your years now end at the river.

choices.text: Press on and cross with them
choices.feedback: The Lord told you not to cross.

choices.text: Gather the people one last time
choices.feedback: You call them with quiet love.

choices.text: Say nothing and slip away alone
choices.feedback: They deserve a farewell.

press_consequence.title: Honor His Word
press_consequence.text:
The Jordan is not yours to cross.
Gather the people instead.

choices.text: Gather the people one last time
choices.feedback: You bow and turn back.

silent_consequence.title: They Need Your Blessing
silent_consequence.text:
Forty years walked together.
Do not leave them in silence.

choices.text: Gather the people one last time
choices.feedback: You raise your staff to call them.

gather_people.title: All Israel Listens
gather_people.text:
Their faces wait, hushed and still.
What words will you give them?

choices.text: Recount your own great deeds
choices.feedback: Your story is His story.

choices.text: Remind them of the Lord's faithfulness
choices.feedback: You speak of manna and sea.

boast_consequence.title: Lift His Name, Not Yours
boast_consequence.text:
He led you. He fed you. He saved you.
Let them remember Him.

choices.text: Remind them of the Lord's faithfulness
choices.feedback: Your voice softens with truth.

blessing.title: A Blessing on the Tribes
blessing.text:
You bless each tribe by name.
Your staff trembles with love.

choices.text: Now appoint your successor
choices.feedback: Leadership must continue.

appoint_joshua.title: Who Will Lead Them?
appoint_joshua.text:
Joshua stands beside you, steady.
The Lord has chosen him.

choices.text: Choose someone of your own bloodline
choices.feedback: The Lord chose Joshua, not kin.

choices.text: Cling to leadership a little longer
choices.feedback: Your time has come to release it.

choices.text: Lay your hands on Joshua
choices.feedback: Spirit and wisdom pass to him.

bloodline_consequence.title: His Choice, Not Yours
bloodline_consequence.text:
Joshua has walked beside you all along.
The Lord has named him.

choices.text: Lay your hands on Joshua
choices.feedback: You turn toward Joshua.

cling_consequence.title: Open Your Hand
cling_consequence.text:
Faithfulness now means letting go.
Give what He asks of you.

choices.text: Lay your hands on Joshua
choices.feedback: Your hands come to rest on him.

joshua_blessed.title: Be Strong and Courageous
joshua_blessed.text:
"The Lord goes before you," you say.
"He will not leave you."

choices.text: Now climb Mount Nebo as God said
choices.feedback: The mountain waits in the dawn.

ascent.title: The Path Up Nebo
ascent.text:
Each step is heavy and holy.
At the top, the Lord will speak.

choices.text: Turn back to the comfort of camp
choices.feedback: He calls you upward, not back.

choices.text: Climb in quiet trust
choices.feedback: Your staff steadies your steps.

turnback_consequence.title: He Waits Above
turnback_consequence.text:
This last climb is His gift to you.
Do not refuse the summit.

choices.text: Climb in quiet trust
choices.feedback: You turn your face upward.

summit.title: All the Land Before You
summit.text:
Valleys and hills shine in gold.
"This is the land," He says.

choices.text: Grieve that you may not enter
choices.feedback: You have already received enough.

choices.text: Demand to cross with the people
choices.feedback: His word is gentle but firm.

choices.text: Receive the vision with thanks
choices.feedback: Tears of joy fall in silence.

grief_consequence.title: Look With Joy, Not Sorrow
grief_consequence.text:
He lets you see what He promised.
This vision is His kindness.

choices.text: Receive the vision with thanks
choices.feedback: Your heart softens at His mercy.

demand_consequence.title: Trust His Boundary
demand_consequence.text:
Joshua will lead them across.
Your part is complete.

choices.text: Receive the vision with thanks
choices.feedback: You bow your head in peace.

vision_received.title: "You Have Seen It With Your Eyes"
vision_received.text:
His voice settles like warm wind.
Your journey draws to its rest.

choices.text: Lie down where He has appointed
choices.feedback: The mountain holds you gently.

ending_peaceful.title: Rest on the Mountain
ending_peaceful.text:
You close your eyes in His presence.
The Lord Himself buries His servant.
